title: Petra and the Will
author: Petra Underhill
blurb: Jonah Vane, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
